strengths_deep_dive: Al-Arqam Islamic School operates with strong financial efficiency. In FY2024, the school achieved a <cite id="1">98.5% program expense ratio</cite>, ensuring that almost all resources directly support academic instruction and campus operations. This beats the standard 75% benchmark for educational nonprofits. Additionally, the organization keeps fundraising costs low at <cite id="1">$0.06 per $1 raised</cite> while holding <cite id="1">9.1 months of working capital reserves</cite> to cushion against short-term economic disruptions.
rich_narrative.summary: Al-Arqam Islamic School provides Islamic education and college preparation to students in the Greater Sacramento area. Established in <cite id="2">1998</cite>, the institution operates elementary, middle, and high school programs using the <cite id="6">International Baccalaureate (IB) framework</cite>. Financial filings show the school generated <cite id="2">$4,330,166 in total revenue in FY2024</cite>, relying primarily on program service fees such as tuition. The organization demonstrates exceptional fiscal efficiency, directing a <cite id="1">98.5% program expense ratio</cite> to educational delivery, which beats the industry standard benchmark of 75%. While the school holds regional accreditation, it does not publish public beneficiary counts or maintain a formal theory of change, which limits full long-term outcome tracking.
